title: "Homework 4"

```{r}
# Question 1

#Creating vector
ndims <- sample(3:10, 1)
print(ndims)
#Reshuffling values
newdims <- sample(1:(ndims^2))
#Creating matrix
mat1 <- matrix(data = newdims, nrow = sqrt(length(newdims)))
print(mat1)
#Transposing matrix
mat1 <- t(mat1)
print(mat1)
sum(mat1[1,])
mean(mat1[1,])
sum(mat1[sqrt(length(newdims)),])
mean(mat1[sqrt(length(newdims)),])
eigenmat <- eigen(mat1) 
typeof(eigenmat$values)
typeof(eigenmat$vectors) #They are all complex

# Question 2

#Creating list
my_matrix <- matrix(runif(16), nrow = 4)
veclog <- runif(100)
my_logical <- veclog>.5
my_letters <- sample(letters)

new_list <- list(my_matrix = my_matrix[2,2], my_logical = my_logical[2], my_letters = my_letters[2])
typeof(new_list$my_matrix) #checking types of data
typeof(new_list$my_logical)
typeof(new_list$my_letters)
new_vec <- c(new_list$my_matrix, new_list$my_logical, new_list$my_letters)
typeof(new_vec) #Checking data type of new vector, they are all characters

# Question 3

#Creating variables
my_unis <- runif(26, min = 0, max= 10)
my_letters <- sample(LETTERS)
#Creating dataframe
df1 <- data.frame(my_unis, my_letters)
#Replacing with NAs
df1[(sample(nrow(df1), size = 4, replace = FALSE)),1] <- NA
df1
which(!complete.cases(df1))
#Putting column 2 in alphabetical order
df1 <- data.frame(df1[,1], sort(df1[,2]))
#Finding mean of column 1
mean(df1[,1], na.rm = T)
```
